events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war shows military strength of the US, but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict has led to a rise in oil prices and increased tensions in the region. The US has imposed sanctions on Iran, which has affected the country's economy.
events.reasoning: The Iran war has led to increased volatility in the market, and the US stock market is expected to be affected. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is a good buy as it provides exposure to the US stock market, while the iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF (EEM) is a good short as emerging markets are expected to be negatively affected by the conflict.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and US-Iran relations

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or US-Iran relations improve
